pieces.Text: Your performance strikes fear in the hearts of foes.

When you start a performance [or a raging song] as a move or swift action, you can use a standard action to demoralize a foe [Core Rulebook 99], attempting a Perform check appropriate to your performance in place of the Intimidate check. Your performance must be one with an audible component.
 If you can start a performance as a swift action and you have the Dazzling Display feat, you can gain the benefit of Dazzling Display by succeeding at a Perform check in place of an Intimidate check.
